' REQ: LANG-2781 LANG-2782 LANG-2783 LANG-2784 ' Greeter module Public Function Greet(Name As String, Optional Times As Integer = 1) As String Dim Text As String = "Hello, " & Name & "!\n" Dim i As Integer For i = 1 To Times Print Text Next Return Text End Public Sub Main() If Len(Greet("gambas", 2)) > 0 And True Then Print &H1F End
